friction.description: agent-browser `find testid "overview-service-tab-<id>" click` reported success without applying the service-period change (state stayed on Dinner); the click appears to land before React handles it on those pill buttons.
friction.resolution: Used an in-page `document.querySelector('[data-testid=...]').click()` via `agent-browser eval` for the service-period switches; the tab then switched immediately.

friction.description: The Overview service period is selected by the URL query param `service` (use-host-stand.ts reads searchParams.get('service')); a reload with `serviceId=` silently fell back to 'All services'.
friction.resolution: Used ?date=...&service=<serviceId> for deep links; not a product defect, only a param-name discovery.
